info.title: Podio Universal API
info.description: Manage workspaces, items, tasks, and collaboration in Podio

post.description: Creates a comment on a Podio object.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

type.description: The type of object to comment on.

id.description: The ID of the object to comment on.

externalId.description: An external ID for the comment, if any.

embedUrl.description: A URL to attach to the comment.

alertInvite.description: Automatically invite mentioned users when needed.

hook.description: Run Podio hooks for the change.

silent.description: Suppress stream bumping and notifications for the comment.
